camel_example: aliyun agentloop GET /agentspace/my-agent-space/pipeline --region cn-hangzhou --pipelineName 'my-pipeline' --scheduleType RunOnce --nextToken 'MTIzNDU2Nzg5MA==' --maxResults 20 --scheduleStatus Active --sinkName 'my-dataset' --header "Content-Type=application/json" --version 2026-05-20 --force
description_en: Queries a list of pipelines. Supports filtering by name, schedule type, and schedule status with cursor-based pagination
description_zh: 查询流水线列表。支持按名称、调度类型、调度状态过滤，Cursor 分页

name: ListPipelines

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. Pipelines under this AgentSpace are listed

parameters.help_en:

RunOnce: One-time execution.
Scheduled: Periodic scheduling
parameters.help_zh: 按调度类型过滤：RunOnce（单次执行）或 Scheduled（周期调度）；不传表示不过滤

Active: Active.
